name: ci-staged
description: Resource economy for a repo where several agents share one build box: run only the specific test/module/benchmark your change needs (never the whole family or a full sweep 'just in case'), and reserve 'run everything' for one serial, locked, once-per-batch post-merge runner that is also the only pusher, bisecting and reverting the culprit on red. Part A is the generic shape; Part B is how a project instantiates it
